items.desc: Iran adds 26 tugboats to Hormuz ‘non-compliance list’ Iran’s Persian Gulf Strait Authority (PGSA) says it has added 26 tugboats to its “non-compliance list”, accusing them of providing services to offending vessels south of the Strait of Hormuz.
